title: Treasury coupon announcement (2Y + 5Y + 7Y notes, 13/26/6-week bills) — sized on Christmas Eve, into a 2:00pm early close
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 initial research. Six rows carry announcement date `Thursday, December 24, 2026`: `13-Week BILL`, `26-Week BILL`, `2-Year NOTE` (auction Monday, December 28; settle Thursday, December 31), `5-Year NOTE` (same auction and settlement dates), `6-Week BILL`, and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday, December 29; settle Thursday, December 31). Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the release itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 never-assessed initial research, which read the schedule's December block looking for its own event's successor. WHY IT IS A GAP AND NOT A DUPLICATE: this calendar already tracks and has researched the November twin (treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19) and the January pair (treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-14, -2027-01-21), plus treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12 — the December month-end announcement is the missing member of an established series, not a new kind. WHAT MAKES IT WORTH ITS OWN ROW: it lands ON Christmas Eve, a session this calendar already tracks as an early close (christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24, and sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31 for the settlement week). The proposing research measured the half-day slot directly and found it is a HALF-DAY phenomenon rather than a holiday one — Treasury's `closing_time_comp` reads 11:30 AM rather than 1:00 PM on 9 of 152 7-Year auctions since 2014, six pre-Thanksgiving AND two Christmas-Eve (2014-12-24, 2025-12-24), the driver being SIFMA's recommended 2:00pm bond close. An 11:00am ET coupon ANNOUNCEMENT into that same shortened session is the untested half of the structure: whoever researches it should check whether Treasury shifts the release time the way it shifts auction times, which the proposing session did not test. SIZE EXPECTATION, carried not derived: the 2Y/5Y/7Y columns of sb0590 read 69 / 70 / 44 in all six monthly rows it publishes and no nominal coupon size has changed since 2024-04, so the note legs should be the easiest call in the release; the bills are where sb0590 reserves flexibility. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook is rates-keyed.
